title: pre_review — the box pre-review's one pass over the whole branch (more-local-inference 09)
description: The box's own review of the whole branch, after the last task and before the hosted whole-branch reviewers (backlog's extra review and merge phase, ralph's standards/spec and Refuter). It is asked for the three things those reviewers judge -- the issue's acceptance criteria, the repository's documented standards, and the issue's scope -- and it FIXES what it can in the code. `pre_review_check` reads this file only for the receipt and the measurement line; a failed or missing receipt reverts the stage's edits. The findings never reach the hosted reviewers: only the code changes do, which is what keeps those reviewers independent. _io is stamped by the server and is not part of this schema.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what you checked, what you changed, and what you could not fix.

criteria.description: One entry per acceptance criterion of the issue, judged the way the Refuter judges it.

criterion.description: The requirement, in one sentence, in the issue's own words where it has them.

status.description: met: you can cite the file and line that implements it. not_met: missing, partial or contradicted by the code. unverifiable: the code and the diff cannot settle it, and you say what evidence is missing.

where.description: path/to/file.ext:LINE for met, or what is missing and where you looked for not_met and unverifiable.

changes.description: Every file you edited, and why. Empty when you changed nothing, which is a good answer for a branch that is already done.

why.description: The rule or smell it violated, or the criterion it now meets.
